tekst o nama 1: Veterinary clinic Love Pet was founded in 2024. It is headed by Jelena Ćosović Šekularac, a specialist in veterinary medicine.
tekst o nama 2: Dr. Jelena graduated in 2009 from the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in Belgrade. During the final years of her studies, she was actively improving herself in the field of pet health care at the Clinic for Small Animals at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in Belgrade, as well as in other clinics.
tekst o nama 3: In 2013, she co-founded the MyVet veterinary clinic team, where she will work until 2024.
tekst o nama 4: She received the title of specialist in 2014 at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in Belgrade, under the mentorship of prof. Ph.D. Vanje Krstić.
tekst o nama 5: She is a member of the Association of Small Practice Veterinarians (SASAP) and the Veterinary Chamber of Serbia. He has a license for independent work from the Veterinary Chamber of Serbia.
tekst o nama 6: Her areas of interest are surgery, cardiology, anesthesiology, emergency veterinary medicine, diseases and treatment of exotic pets (rabbits, parrots, guinea pigs, hamsters, turtles...), ultrasound diagnostics and internal veterinary medicine. She completes his professional training by regularly attending numerous congresses and seminars.
